problem: Task: Build an automated ticket classification system.
goals: Task: Build an automated ticket classification system.
constraints: - Must exceed 90% accuracy on top 20 categories
- Must handle tickets in English and Spanish
- Needs a human-in-the-loop for low-confidence predictions
Note: We use AWS and prefer SageMaker if possible. Don't overthink the infrastructure — focus on the ML approach.
context_facts: Context: I have a dataset of 10M customer support tickets with resolution categories. Currently agents manually categorize them. Accuracy of manual categorization is about 85%.
